keyVerseDR: "It is a more blessed thing to give, rather than to receive." (Acts 20:35)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Kindness
level1.story: Kindness means doing good and helping people. A kind heart is generous and loves to share!
level1.keyLine: It is better to give than to receive.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice kindness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What kind or generous thing did we see this week?
What can our family share with others?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Jesus, make my heart kind and generous. Help me give with joy, like You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Share a toy or snack with someone
TUE: Help someone who needs a hand
WED: Say something kind to a classmate
THU: Give a smile to everyone you meet
FRI: Make a gift for someone
SAT: Put a coin in the poor box at church

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Kindness
level2.story: Kindness means doing good things for others, helping them, and caring for them. A kind heart is also a generous heart: it shares toys, time, and treats without expecting anything back. Jesus said it is more blessed to give than to receive. Every kind act, big or small, is a way of loving Jesus, who said that what we do for others we do for Him.
level2.keyLine: It is better to give than to receive.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice kindness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What kind or generous thing did we see this week?
How did God help us grow in kindness?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Jesus, make my heart kind and generous. Help me give with joy, like You. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Do a secret kind deed for a family member
TUE: Give away a toy or book in good shape
WED: Help a neighbor with a small job
THU: Include someone who is often left out
FRI: Write a kind note to a teacher
SAT: Save money to give to people in need

art.mainBrief: A Catholic family practicing kindness together at home
art.heartBrief: Stars and a family around a heart
